evals.prompt: Set up a brand-new monorepo for our project 'acme-platform' so Claude Code and other agents can navigate it. It'll hold a frontend, a backend, and some workers.
evals.expected_output: A scaffolded repository with AGENTS.md, the default docs/ structure, a components/ central folder, and validation templates. AGENTS.md links every created docs entrypoint, and the scaffold prints a stable JSON summary of what it created.
assertions: A root AGENTS.md file is created
docs/index.md is created as the documentation table of contents
A components/ central folder is created (monorepo target)
AGENTS.md links to docs/index.md and the other created docs entrypoints
The scaffold helper prints a JSON summary of created files/directories
The monorepo entrypoint section is named 'Component Entrypoints'

evals.prompt: We need a sites repo for ollem.io, and there's also a mobile version of the site. Scaffold it for us.
evals.expected_output: Because a sites project has a mobile variant, the agent asks one concise question about the preferred naming pattern (e.g. m-ollem-io vs ollem-io.mobile) before creating folders, then scaffolds a sites/ layout using the normalized domain folder name ollem-io.
assertions: The agent asks one concise question about the mobile naming pattern before creating folders
It offers concrete options such as 'm-ollem-io' or 'ollem-io.mobile'
After a choice is made, a sites/ollem-io folder is created (domain normalized with hyphens)
AGENTS.md uses the 'Site Entrypoints' section name for the sites target

evals.prompt: Here's our existing Node service repo — it has a package.json but no AGENTS.md and no docs/. Adopt it into the agent-friendly structure.
evals.expected_output: For an adopt target the agent does NOT immediately restructure files. It maps the current repo, classifies package.json as an entrypoint marker, reports the gaps (missing AGENTS.md, missing docs, missing standards), and explains what must change before applying any migration.
assertions: The output is an adoption/migration plan, not an immediate bulk restructuring of files
It identifies the missing AGENTS.md and missing docs/ structure
It classifies package.json as an entrypoint marker file
It does not delete or move existing files without first explaining the change
